flagged.title: Reactivity of Metals and Metal Extraction
flagged.reason: Stating that magnesium and aluminium react vigorously with water teaches a direct syllabus misconception that will lose marks on exam questions about metal reactions with water.

mark_affecting.quote: Up at the top you've got potassium, sodium, calcium, magnesium, and aluminium. These are your heavy hitters. They react vigorously with water and acids.
